subhead.text: Online booking and automatic reminders in one app, built for small clinics and the people at their front desk.

context_line.text: When every booking comes in by phone, the front desk spends the morning answering calls and moving visits while the first slots of the day sit empty.

body.text: Patients get a text and an email before every visit and confirm or move it in one tap, so a gap opens early enough to refill.

proof_line.text: No-shows down 38% in clinics' first six months

body.text: Your booking page shows live openings for each practitioner. A patient picks a time late in the evening without calling, and it lands in the right calendar.

proof_line.text: 41% of clinic bookings are made between 6pm and 8am
